description: This course allows students to serve on the editorial board of the Pi Sigma Alpha Undergraduate Journal of Politics, the national undergraduate journal of the political science honor society. Students learn how scholarly research is evaluated, revised, and prepared for publication by reviewing manuscripts and participating in editorial workflows. The course also introduces the norms of scholarly publishing. Students may take this course a second time, serving as Senior Editors, with enhanced leadership roles and editorial opportunities. Offered annually during fall and spring semesters. Prerequisites: Junior or senior standing, PSCI 220 and 2 additional political science courses, or instructor permission. Other interested students should reach out to the faculty member teaching the course.
